   293	            (AlgHom.id M.1

   298	    P.thetaN.comp P.rightN = P.leftN.comp P.tauN := by
   299	  exact (pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFacePackage
   300	    C L n m relation M mapM e hmapM N U V W thetaN hthetaN).face

    29	
    30	/-- The left factor inclusion into the tensor pushout selected by two algebra maps. -/
    31	noncomputable def finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft
    32	    {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    33	    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    34	    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    35	    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    36	    B₁ →ₐ[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂ := by
    37	  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁

    39	  letI := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁

    60	noncomputable def finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension
    61	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    62	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]

    67	/-- The arbitrary-scalar tensor-pushout equivalence on a pure tensor. -/
    68	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_tmul

    71	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]

    74	    letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
    75	    letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
    76	    letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁

    95	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_faceLeft
    96	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    97	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    98	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    99	    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) (c : K) (b₁ : B₁) :
   100	    letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁

   106	    let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   107	      (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)

   110	    finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension f₁ f₂
   111	        (c ⊗ₜ[R] (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft f₁ f₂ b₁)) =
   112	      (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₁) ⊗ₜ[K ⊗[R] A] 1 := by
   113	  dsimp only
   114	  letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
   115	  letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
   116	  letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
   117	  letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
   118	  let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   119	    (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
   120	  let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   121	    (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
   122	  letI := kf₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   123	  letI := kf₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   124	  change finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension f₁ f₂
   125	      (c ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ ⊗ₜ[A] 1)) =
   126	    (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₁) ⊗ₜ[K ⊗[R] A] 1
   127	  exact finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_tmul f₁ f₂ c b₁ 1

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.TensorProductFieldTowerMap
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleModelScalarExtension
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Map-level faces for finite-stage triple-model scalar extension
    11	
    12	The canonical scalar-extension equivalence for a tensor pushout carries the scalar
    13	extension of each original face map to the corresponding face of the scalar-extended
    14	pushout.  These map equalities strengthen the pointwise pure-tensor formulas and can be
    15	composed directly with descended triple-transition maps.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	open TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	/-- Scalar extension of the left face, followed by the tensor-pushout base-change
    30	equivalence, is the left face of the scalar-extended pushout. -/
    31	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_faceLeft_map
    32	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    33	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    34	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    35	    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    36	    let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    37	      (R := R) (K := K) f₁
    38	    let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    39	      (R := R) (K := K) f₂
    40	    let beta :
    41	        (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
    42	          Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    43	      finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
    44	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
    45	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    46	          (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft f₁ f₂)) =
    47	      finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft kf₁ kf₂ := by
    48	  dsimp only
    49	  let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    50	    (R := R) (K := K) f₁
    51	  let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    52	    (R := R) (K := K) f₂
    53	  let beta :
    54	      (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
    55	        Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    56	    finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
    57	  let lhs :
    58	      (K ⊗[R] B₁) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    59	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
    60	      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    61	        (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft f₁ f₂))
    62	  let rhs :
    63	      (K ⊗[R] B₁) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
    64	    finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceLeft kf₁ kf₂
    65	  change lhs = rhs
    66	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    67	  intro x
    68	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    69	  | zero => exact lhs.map_zero.trans rhs.map_zero.symm
    70	  | add x y hx hy =>
    71	      calc
    72	        lhs (x + y) = lhs x + lhs y := lhs.map_add x y
    73	        _ = rhs x + rhs y := congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
    74	        _ = rhs (x + y) := (rhs.map_add x y).symm
    75	  | tmul c b₁ =>
    76	      letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
    77	      letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
    78	      letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
    79	      letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
    80	      let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
    81	        (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
    82	      let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
    83	        (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
    84	      letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    85	      letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    86	      change
    87	        AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom
    88	            (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂)
    89	            (c ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B₂))) =
    90	          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    91	            (R := K ⊗[R] A) (S := K) (A := K ⊗[R] B₁) (B := K ⊗[R] B₂)
    92	            (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₁)
    93	      rw [AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom_tmul]
    94	      rfl
    95	
    96	/-- Scalar extension of the right face, followed by the tensor-pushout base-change
    97	equivalence, is the right face of the scalar-extended pushout. -/
    98	theorem finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension_faceRight_map
    99	    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
   100	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
   101	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
   102	    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
   103	    let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   104	      (R := R) (K := K) f₁
   105	    let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   106	      (R := R) (K := K) f₂
   107	    let beta :
   108	        (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
   109	          Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   110	      finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
   111	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
   112	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   113	          (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight f₁ f₂)) =
   114	      finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight kf₁ kf₂ := by
   115	  dsimp only
   116	  let kf₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   117	    (R := R) (K := K) f₁
   118	  let kf₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   119	    (R := R) (K := K) f₂
   120	  let beta :
   121	      (K ⊗[R] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) ≃ₐ[K]
   122	        Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   123	    finiteStageTensorPushoutScalarExtension (K := K) f₁ f₂
   124	  let lhs :
   125	      (K ⊗[R] B₂) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   126	    beta.toAlgHom.comp
   127	      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   128	        (R := R) (K := K) (finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight f₁ f₂))
   129	  let rhs :
   130	      (K ⊗[R] B₂) →ₐ[K] Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing kf₁ kf₂ :=
   131	    finiteStageTensorPushoutFaceRight kf₁ kf₂
   132	  change lhs = rhs
   133	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   134	  intro x
   135	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   136	  | zero => exact lhs.map_zero.trans rhs.map_zero.symm
   137	  | add x y hx hy =>
   138	      calc
   139	        lhs (x + y) = lhs x + lhs y := lhs.map_add x y
   140	        _ = rhs x + rhs y := congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
   141	        _ = rhs (x + y) := (rhs.map_add x y).symm
   142	  | tmul c b₂ =>
   143	      have hunit :
   144	          lhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) =
   145	            rhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := by
   146	        letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
   147	        letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
   148	        letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
   149	        letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
   150	        let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   151	          (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
   152	        let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
   153	          (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
   154	        letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   155	        letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   156	        change
   157	          AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom
   158	              (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂)
   159	              ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] ((1 : B₁) ⊗ₜ[A] b₂)) =
   160	            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
   161	              (R := K ⊗[R] A) (A := K ⊗[R] B₁) (B := K ⊗[R] B₂)
   162	                ).restrictScalars K) ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)
   163	        rw [AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChangeHom_tmul]
   164	        rfl
   165	      have hcb :
   166	          c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ = c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := by
   167	        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
   168	        simp
   169	      calc
   170	        lhs (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) =
   171	            lhs (c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)) := congrArg lhs hcb
   172	        _ = c • lhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) :=
   173	          lhs.toLinearMap.map_smul c _
   174	        _ = c • rhs ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) :=
   175	          congrArg (fun z => c • z) hunit
   176	        _ = rhs (c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] b₂)) :=
   177	          (rhs.toLinearMap.map_smul c _).symm
   178	        _ = rhs (c ⊗ₜ[R] b₂) := congrArg rhs hcb.symm
   179	
   180	end

   496	/-!
   497	
   498	## Locally directed gluing
   499	
   500	We say that a diagram of open immersions is "locally directed" if for any `V, W ⊆ U` in the diagram,
   501	`V ∩ W` is a union of elements in the diagram. Equivalently, for every `x ∈ U` in the diagram,
   502	the set of elements containing `x` is directed (and hence the name).
   503	
   504	For such a diagram, we can glue them directly since the gluing conditions are always satisfied.
   505	The intended usage is to provide the following instances:
   506	- `∀ {i j} (f : i ⟶ j), IsOpenImmersion (F.map f)`
   507	- `(F ⋙ forget).IsLocallyDirected`
   508	
   509	and to directly use the `colimit` API.
   510	Also see `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover` for the open cover of the `colimit`.
   511	
   512	-/
   513	section IsLocallyDirected
   514	
   515	open TopologicalSpace.Opens
   516	
   517	universe w
   518	
   519	variable {J : Type w} [Category.{v} J] (F : J ⥤ Scheme.{u})
   520	variable [∀ {i j} (f : i ⟶ j), IsOpenImmersion (F.map f)]

===== lft descent =====
   250	theorem picEtClauseOne_of_picSharp_representableBy_locallyOfFiniteType
   251	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   252	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   253	    (h : ∃ X : Over (Spec (.of k)),
   254	      Nonempty ((Scheme.PicScheme.picSharp C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
   255	        LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom) :
   256	    ∃ X : Over (Spec (.of k)),

   260	  have repEt := Scheme.picSharp_representableBy_picEt_transport C rep
   261	  exact ⟨X, ⟨repEt⟩, hlft, isSeparated_of_representableBy_picEt C repEt⟩

   263	/-! ## §4. Field 2, for contrast: it DOES descend, at the route's own cover -/
   264	
   265	/-- **Field 2 descends along the field-extension cover.** If the base change of
   266	`X` to `k'` is locally of finite type over `Spec k'`, then `X` is locally of
   267	finite type over `Spec k`, for an **arbitrary** field extension `k'/k`.
   268	
   269	Recorded here, beside field 3, because the *contrast* is the planning fact: field
   270	2 is free by a **descent** argument (Mathlib has
   271	`DescendsAlong @LocallyOfFiniteType (@Surjective ⊓ @Flat ⊓ @QuasiCompact)`, and
   272	`Spec.map (algebraMap k k')` satisfies all three by synthesis — surjectivity from
   273	`Scheme.surjective_specMap_algebraMap`, the other two outright), while field 3 is
   274	free *only* because descent is unavailable for it and the group structure
   275	substitutes. A lane that priced the two conjuncts together would get one of them
   276	right for the wrong reason.
   277	
   278	**AN EARLIER REVISION CARRIED `[Algebra.IsSeparable k k']` AND `[Module.Finite k k']`
   279	HERE AND CONSUMED NEITHER, and both are now deleted** (`I-1356`, `I-1362`;
   280	reproduced before accepting: the body verbatim elaborates with the binders removed,
   281	`lake env lean` `EXIT=0`, and the control still discriminates — with `h` dropped,
   282	`LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom` by `infer_instance` **fails**). None of the three
   283	ingredients needs them: surjectivity holds for any field extension because both
   284	spectra are one-point, flatness because `k` is a field, quasi-compactness because
   285	the source is affine.
   286	
   287	That matters for a costing and not only for tidiness. Finite separability is
   288	**input 1's** price — `Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees`
   289	(`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean`) genuinely needs both binders, measured: deleting
   290	them there gives `synthInstanceFailed`. Field 2 does not pay it, so a lane reading
   291	this file as it stood budgeted separability **twice**. The seam docstring had
   292	already corrected exactly this double-count once, at input 2; this was a second
   293	instance of it one file over. The binders are removed rather than the sentence
   294	requalified, because a binder no proof consumes keeps the trap for the next reader
   295	however carefully the prose around it is written.
   296	
   297	Nothing about `picEt` occurs: this is a statement about an arbitrary `k`-scheme,
   298	and it is stated at that generality on purpose so that no reader takes it for a
   299	fact about the Picard functor. -/
   300	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_of_baseChange {k : Type u} [Field k] (k' : Type u)
   301	    [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
   302	    {X : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   303	    (h : LocallyOfFiniteType
   304	      (Limits.pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) X.hom)) :
   305	    LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom := by
   306	  have hQ : (@Surjective ⊓ @Flat ⊓ @QuasiCompact : MorphismProperty Scheme)
   307	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :=
   308	    ⟨⟨Scheme.surjective_specMap_algebraMap k k', inferInstance⟩, inferInstance⟩
   309	  exact MorphismProperty.of_pullback_fst_of_descendsAlong hQ h
